title: The Last Umbrella on Platform Four
protagonist: Aris, a retired stationmaster with a weathered coat
setting: A rain-soaked commuter train platform at dusk
story: Every evening at six, retired stationmaster Aris stood beneath the leaking roof of Platform Four, holding a bright yellow umbrella he never opened for himself. Years ago, his daughter missed the last train home in a winter storm, and a stranger had given her his warm coat. Since she moved abroad, Aris kept that quiet debt alive. Tonight, the downpour was merciless. A soaking-wet university student sat trembling on a wooden bench, clutching a ruined portfolio of architectural drawings. Aris walked over, opened the yellow umbrella above her head, and placed a warm thermos of tea beside her bag. Looking up through tears, she whispered that she had failed her final jury. Aris smiled gently toward the arriving train. One storm never ruins the whole blueprint, he said.
caption: One small act of kindness can shelter someone when their whole world feels like it is pouring down.
